title: Brightness of original-design Starlink satellites at 550 km

satellite.name: Starlink V1.0 (original design)
satellite.notes: Flat nadir-facing bus plus one solar array, no visor. Model: data/satellite_models/starlink_v1_0.json (design page M4).

phase_fit_linear.locator: Table 2, 'Phase angle' row (slope not significant; se 0.672)

flat_panel_fit.form: m1000 = b + mFP * (-2.5 log10(M N)); M, N = projections of the nadir-facing side toward the observer and toward the Sun (section 2, Figures 1-2)
flat_panel_fit.locator: section 4.3, equation 1; Table 2 'Flat-panel' row (7 sigma; se 0.654)

shell.locator: altitude: section 4; inclination not stated in the paper (Starlink shell 1 is 53.0 deg)

constraints.note: Selection limits are not stated. Magnitudes were reduced to 1000 km and phase angles computed by T. Molczan (section 3).

transcription.method: pdftotext -raw (Table 1 and Table 2 read in row order)
transcription.check: summary only: the paper does not publish individual observations
